overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. Draft minutes did not exist when the request was made, and the Board timely acknowledged it and later sent a cost estimate once minutes were created.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the library board failed to respond to his request for minutes of its March 13, 2014 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by not providing the minutes within 10 days of the request because the meeting minutes had not been drafted as of the date of the request.
